rules.statement: A person who is put to his election must have clear proof that he was acquainted with his rights and the necessity of making an election, and he must unequivocally make his election.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order that a person who is put to his election should be concluded by it, two things are necessary. First, a full knowledge of the inconsistent rights and of the necessity of electing between them. Second, an intention to elect manifested either expressly or by acts which imply choice and acquiescence."
